title: pkg/version: index out of range parsing dlocate output
body:
[`version.go:42`](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/blob/main/common/pkg/version/version.go) checks `len(f) >= 2` and then indexes `f[2]`:

```go
f := strings.Fields(line)
if len(f) >= 2 {
	return f[1] + "_" + f[2]
}
```

Any `dlocate -l` line with exactly two fields panics:

```
panic: runtime error: index out of range [2] with length 2
```

This parses the output of an external command ... so it should not assume the shape ig

Separately: `version.go:31` shadows `output` with `:=` inside the case block, so the
function can return all matches instead of the first.
